transcript.content: Hello, welcome. What brings you in to see me today?
I'm here because I have been feeling extremely depressed lately. Everything just feels completely heavy and empty, and I don't know what to do anymore.
I'm very sorry to hear that you're feeling this way. How long have you been experiencing these feelings of depression and emptiness?
It has been about three months now. Every single day just feels completely blank and heavy, and I can't seem to shake it.

Have you ever experienced periods of time lasting a few days or more where you felt the opposite of depressed—such as having unusually high energy, needing very little sleep, or feeling on top of the world?
No, I have never experienced anything like that. I've never had periods of high energy or felt on top of the world. It has always just been the opposite for me.
Did these feelings of depression start after a specific stressful event or major change in your life, such as a loss, a breakup, or trouble at work?
No, I can't recall any specific stressful event, loss, or major change that triggered this. It didn't seem to be caused by anything in particular; these feelings just started happening on their own.
